overview_description.description:
The Buttermilk Company provides Indian foods made with fresh and locally sourced vegetables. The company's goal is to provide access to authentic cultures and cuisines in the easiest and simplest way possible.

The Buttermilk Company launched in a small kitchen in Seattle in October 2017.
